reason: $24.99 for the first box is a fair launch deal and the money-back guarantee means little risk, so I'd try one box. I would not stock up until I know it does something.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? And I forget my vitamins half the time, so I might not even finish the 30 sachets.
would_change_my_mind: If the launch price were gone and it was the full $29.99 with no coupon, I would wait for a flash sale.
